name: onMouseOver
description: Fired when the pointer moves over a chart element. Fields that do not apply to the element are omitted.

componentType.description: ECharts component the pointer event belongs to, e.g. 'series', 'markPoint', 'xAxis'.

seriesType.description: Series type, e.g. 'bar', 'line', 'pie'. Present when componentType is 'series'.

seriesIndex.description: Index of the series in option.series.

name.description: Name of the data item, or the category name.

dataIndex.description: Index of the data item within the series.

data.description: The raw data item as given in the option.

dataType.description: For series with more than one kind of data, which one the item belongs to, e.g. 'node' or 'edge' in a graph.

value.description: Value of the data item: a number, or an array for multi-dimensional data.

color.description: Colour of the data item: a CSS colour string, or a gradient/pattern object.

percent.description: Share of the total in percent. Pie, funnel and similar series only.
